origin.description: This is a constructor for the Doctype class that can be provided at the top of an XML document to provide information about the class of document, i.e. its DTD or schema. Also, there is a method for converting such a Doctype object to a character string.

arguments.name: system
arguments.text: the system URI that locates the DTD.

arguments.name: public
arguments.text: the identifier for locating the DTD in a catalog, for example. This should be a character vector of length 2, giving the public identifier and a URI. If just the public identifier is given and a string is given for system argument, the system value is used as the second element of public.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: the name of the root element in the document.

origin.details: The public identifer should be of the form +//creator//name//language where the first element is either + or -, and the language is described by a code in the ISO 639 document.

translation.description: This is a constructor for the Doctype class that can be provided at the top of an XML document to provide information about the class of document, i.e. its DTD or schema. Also, there is a method for converting such a Doctype object to a character string.

arguments.name: system
arguments.text: the system URI that locates the DTD.

arguments.name: public
arguments.text: the identifier for locating the DTD in a catalog, for example. This should be a sequence of length 2, giving the public identifier and a URI. If just the public identifier is given and a string is given for system, the system value is used as the second element of public.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: the name of the root element in the document.

translation.details: Use as_character to match R's as(d, "character").
translation.example:
from XML.Doctype import Doctype, as_character
d = Doctype(name="section", public=["-//OASIS//DTD DocBook XML V4.2//EN", "http://oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/4.2/docbookx.dtd"])
print(as_character(d))
d = Doctype(name="section", public=["-//OASIS//DTD DocBook XML V4.2//EN"], system="http://oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/4.2/docbookx.dtd")
print(as_character(d))
